name: Basic Python Fix Suite
description: Deterministic Python coding tasks using local environment.

cases.task: Fix the function in calculator.py so that add(2, 3) returns 5. Currently it returns 0.

expected_files.calculator.py:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

cases.test_command: python3 -c 'from calculator import add; assert add(2, 3) == 5'
